Compute Renkonen distances

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
compute_renkonen_distances.Rd

Calculate pairwise Renkonen distances between sample-replicates.

Usage

compute_renkonen_distances(
  read_count,
  compare_all = FALSE,
  outfile = NULL,
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

read_count

Data frame or csv file with asv, sample, replicate, and read_count columns.

compare_all

Logical. If TRUE, compute Renkonen distances for all pairs of sample-replicates. If FALSE, compute distances only between replicates of the same sample.

outfile

Character string specifying the CSV file to write the output data frame. If NULL, no file is written.

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

Value

Data frame with columns: sample1, sample2, replicate1, replicate2, renkonen_d, sample_comp (indicating "within" if sample1 equals sample2, "between" otherwise).

Details

Distances can be computed either between all sample-replicate pairs (compare_all = TRUE) or only between replicates within the same sample (compare_all = FALSE).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
compute_renkonen_distances(read_count_df, compare_all = FALSE)
} # }
